The Hidden Price of Being Single
youtube_short.description: Being single is one of the most expensive financial situations in America — and almost nobody does the math. Between housing costs (you pay 100% alone), the married filing jointly tax break you never get, and insurance surcharges that target single people, the lifetime penalty crosses $1 million. Here's where every dollar goes — and how to build around it. Follow for more money facts that change how you think. #personalfinance #moneytips #singletax #financefacts
